import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find seed diagonal of 1s: cells with 1 forming down-right diagonal pair; extend
    ones=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==1]
    ones.sort()
    # start extension from the last 1 of the topmost diagonal chain
    for i,j in ones:
        if (i+1,j+1) in ones:
            r,c=i+1,j+1
            while r+1<h and c+1<w:
                r,c=r+1,c+1
                if g[r][c] not in (1,g[0][0]): break
                if g[r][c]==1: continue
                g[r][c]=1
            break
    return g
print(transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
out=transform(G['Test input']); print(out==G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(out) if False else out)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # maximal diagonal segments (len>=2) per direction
    segs=[]
    for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
        seen=set()
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                    # only start if not continuation
                    pi,pj=i-dr,j-dc
                    if 0<=pi<h and 0<=pj<w and g[pi][pj]==g[i][j]: continue
                    cells=[(i,j)]; r,c=i,j
                    while True:
                        r,c=r+dr,c+dc
                        if not(0<=r<h and 0<=c<w) or g[r][c]!=g[i][j]: break
                        cells.append((r,c))
                    for cl in cells: seen.add(cl)
                    if len(cells)>=2: segs.append((g[i][j],cells))
    for col,cells in segs:
        rs=[a for a,b in cells]; cs=[b for a,b in cells]
        bbox=set((r,c) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1) for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1))
        inside=all(cl in bbox for cl in cells)
        # skip segments entirely inside a small solid block (demo1 5s)
        if inside and max(rs)-min(rs)<=1 and max(cs)-min(cs)<=1 and len(bbox)==len(cells):
            pass_check=True
        else:
            pass_check=False
        if inside and max(rs)-min(rs)<=1 and max(cs)-min(cs)<=1 and len(bbox)==len(cells) and True:
            # fully packed 2x2-ish: check surroundings for other colors forming block
            others=set(g[r][c] for cl in bbox for r,c in [cl]) if False else None
        # decide: skip if segment is the packed diagonal of a 2x2 block with other colors adjacent
        skip=False
        if len(cells)==2 and abs(cells[0][0]-cells[1][0])==1:
            (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=cells
            if c1>c2: r1,c1,r2,c2=r2,c2,r1,c1
            # cells: (r1,c1) then (r2,c2) with r2=r1+1,c2=c1+1... adjust for both directions
        # simpler: skip if all 4 cells of the 2x2 bbox are non-background
        if len(cells)==2 and max(rs)-min(rs)==1 and max(cs)-min(cs)==1:
            block=[(r,c) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1) for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)]
            if all(g[r][c]!=bg for r,c in block): skip=True
        if skip: continue
        dr=1 if cells[1][0]>cells[0][0] else -1
        dc=1 if cells[1][1]>cells[0][1] else -1
        # normalize ordering
        cells2=sorted(cells)
        if cells2[1][1]<cells2[0][1]: dr,dc=1,-1
        else: dr,dc=1,1
        r,c=cells2[0]
        while True:
            r,c=r-dr,c-dc
            if not(0<=r<h and 0<=c<w) or g[r][c]!=bg: break
            g[r][c]=col
        r,c=cells2[-1]
        while True:
            r,c=r+dr,c+dc
            if not(0<=r<h and 0<=c<w) or g[r][c]!=bg: break
            g[r][c]=col
    return g
for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 2 input']:
